historic_survey.note: Named among the neighbourhood's historic school buildings and described as eclectic — Classical in the Corinthian columns carrying the façade's arcade, Moorish in the tile work, Spanish Revival overall. It and Sanchez Elementary School replaced the earlier Everett Elementary on Sanchez Street in the 1920s.

building.completed_conflict: The statement dates Everett to 1925 in one passage and 1927 in another; the assessor's roll records no year built for this parcel and classes it a vacant lot in public use.
